title: Highly active Pd-doped ZnCo2Se4 spinel nanoelectrocatalysts for synergistic hydrogen evolution and methanol/urea oxidation–assisted water splitting validated by DFT
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00383D, Paper
Mai Almohaimeed, Refah Saad Alkhaldi, Mohammed Ashraf Gondal, Munirah Abdullah Almessiere, Mohamed Jaffer Sadiq Mohamed, Abdulhadi Baykal, Serkan Caliskan
Highly active palladium-doped spinel zinc cobalt selenide (PZCS)-coated nickel foam (ZnPdxCo2−xSe4 (x ≤ 0.08)@NF) nanoelectrocatalysts were prepared via a two-step hydrothermal method.
